verdict.rationale: incident.io clearly has on-call schedules, but the evidence pack never mentions engineer self-service overrides, shift swaps, or coverage requests. Adjacent features such as importing personal time-off via iCal feeds, generic schedule-building docs, and webhooks for schedule changes do not show an engineer can take an override or swap a shift without an admin. The axis applies to this on-call product, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, I can take an override, swap a shift, or request coverage without an admin rebuilding the schedule
